name: web-ux-engineer
description: Design, implement, and audit user flows in web apps and SPAs. Use for interaction choices, forms, feedback, navigation context, and recovery. Deliver verified changes or evidence-backed UX findings; route visual direction, UI-rule audits, and framework mechanics to their owners.

interface.short_description: Implement and audit web user flows
interface.default_prompt: Use $web-ux-engineer to improve or audit this user flow, choose a suitable interaction, and verify the supported result.

name: frontend-design
description: Design and implement visual strategies for web interfaces: landing pages, product UI, dashboards, and redesigns. Own composition, typography, styling, and motion; express accepted interactions and verify rendered results. Route task-flow choices and UX audits to web-ux-engineer.

interface.short_description: Design and implement visual strategy for web UI
interface.default_prompt: Use $frontend-design to express accepted behavior through a grounded visual strategy, reuse the UI system, and verify the rendered result.

name: web-ui-reviewer
description: Review web UI implementation against project rules and Web Interface Guidelines: accessibility, rendered states, forms, content, and measured performance. Deliver scoped findings; route task-flow UX audits to web-ux-engineer. No implementation or conformance certification.

interface.default_prompt: Use $web-ui-reviewer to review this UI implementation against applicable interface and accessibility rules, with scoped findings and evidence limits.

name: react-spa-engineer
description: Build, review, and diagnose React SPAs with TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form, Zod, React Router, and Dexie. Own app integration and runtime correctness; route UX choices, visual direction, and formal UI audits to their owners. Excludes SSR/RSC/Next.js.

interface.short_description: Build and verify integrated React SPA flows
interface.default_prompt: Use $react-spa-engineer to implement or assess this React SPA flow across routing, data, forms, and state, preserving the accepted interaction and verifying runtime behavior.
